Hi Mina,

Thanks again for setting up the demo for tomorrow (Tue 10/6 at 10:00 AM PT). I just heard that our VP of Product, Karen Liu, needs to attend and she was just put on travel for tomorrow morning — she won't be able to join at that time.

Can we please move the session to either Thu 10/8 or Fri 10/9? Morning PT (10:00–11:30 PT) would be ideal for our team. If those slots don't work, we can also do an early-afternoon option (1:00–2:00 PT).

Apologies for the late change — this is driven by the stakeholder schedule. We want Karen in the room for the run-through.

Thanks — appreciate a few alternate slots and whether the same SE will be available.

Alex Rivera

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up. Totally understand wanting Karen on the call.

Quick update from my side: Dylan (SE) is scheduled to do the session tomorrow morning but he has an overlapping customer deep-dive on Thu 10/8 from 9:30–11:30 PT, so he will not be available in the 10:00–11:30 window on 10/8. I checked with our calendar team and we have two practical options:

- Keep Dylan as the SE and move the demo to Fri 10/9 at 10:00 AM PT (Dylan is free).
- Move the session to Thu 10/8 at 11:00 AM PT and have Jonas (another SE who has been briefed on OrbitTech) lead the demo — Jonas is available and can cover the same product agenda.

I attached the current demo-agenda.pdf and a short mutual-action-plan.xlsx so you can see the planned talking points and required pre-demo items. If you prefer Jonas for Thu 10/8, we can also schedule a 15-minute pre-demo sync between Jonas and Karen (or you) earlier the same day.

Proposed times (all PT):
- Thu 10/8 — 11:00 AM (Jonas available)
- Fri 10/9 — 10:00 AM (Dylan available)
- Fri 10/9 — 1:00 PM (alternate)

Please let me know which of the three options works best and whether you'd like the pre-demo sync.

Thanks,
Mina
